title: Strange botanical: Prism Lungwort After the Cloudburst

title: Strange botanical: Lantern-Lattice Mangrove

prompt:

Make the plant itself unmistakable at thumbnail scale: a broad living bridge of porcelain-white lattice stems arches between two ordinary mangrove trunks across dark tidal water, occupying most of the frame. The strange plant is a stilt-root epiphyte, not a fungus, sculpture, coral, artificial trellis, or animal. Hundreds of fist-sized amber bladder-fruits hang from the underside like biological lanterns; each fruit has a delicate veined membrane, pale green calyx, condensed droplets, and a visible cluster of spiral-winged seeds inside. Several ripe fruits have split along clean radial seams, releasing cream-and-copper seeds that spin down toward the outgoing tide. Show the reproductive event clearly without text.
